title: Give the required documents before a long-stay agreement
what: Give a prospective long-stay tenant the required documents (including any disclosure statement) before the agreement, at least 5 working days before for a site-only agreement.

sources.title: Residential Parks (Long-stay Tenants) Act 2006 (WA)
sources.quote: A park operator must give the required documents to a person before entering into a long-stay agreement with the person — (a) for a site-only agreement — at least 5 working days before the agreement is signed;
